introduction: A factual, understated snapshot of the work I do and the systems I want to keep learning from.

entries.description: Contributing to applications and services that support quantitative risk-management and risk-adjustment workflows. The work stretches across frontend, backend, data, and the technical decisions that connect them.
responsibilities: Crafting interface architecture with React and TypeScript.
Designing Java and Spring services around real operational constraints.
Working across SQL data flows, business logic, and user-facing product details.

entries.description: Developed an NLP-based tool to address inconsistent metadata element names across platforms including Collibra and EMH. The tool analyzed business data-element descriptions to generate related technical data elements and presented results with confidence scores.
responsibilities: Developed an NLP model for inconsistent metadata element names across Collibra and EMH.
Built analysis of business data-element descriptions to generate related technical data elements.
Implemented a user-friendly interface for data-element inputs, generated outputs, and confidence scores.

entries.description: Contributed to SURABHI.io, a Social Commerce application from Deep-Tech Computing Private Limited that helps local businesses around the world.
responsibilities: Worked on the Django web application.
Worked on the React Native mobile application.

entries.description: Implemented React Native components and integrated third-party libraries for the application experience.
responsibilities: Implemented a range of React Native components.
Integrated third-party libraries including navigation and NativeBase.
Collaborated with quality developers, designers, and fellow interns.
